testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-percent-off-order-coupon-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify percent off order coupon functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user (the selected profile) checks a Percent Off Order coupon: rejected below the order minimum with two products at qty 1, applied when both are raised to quantity 8 (percent of the whole subtotal). As a guest (non-selected profile) the coupon is rejected. No order.
steps: Sign in as the registered user, empty the cart and remove any coupon
Add sku1 and sku2 at qty 1, apply couponCode: Invalid coupon code, no discount
Raise both lines (found by name1, name2) to updatedQuantity: success message, coupon row, discount label
Check discount = discountAmount% x subtotal and order total = subtotal - discount
Empty the cart, log out; as guest add both products at updatedQuantity and apply couponCode: not applied, Invalid coupon code
stateChanges: Coupon is created per run through the API (consumable COUPON_* key); the test only applies and removes it, no order is placed, so one redemption is enough
Registered user's cart and guest cart: products added, coupon applied/removed, emptied at cleanup
assertions: Below minimum: invalid message "- " + invalidCouponMessage, coupon row shows couponCode, no discount
Both lines at updatedQuantity; success message "- " + promoAppliedSuccesssMessage; coupon row shows couponCode; discount label visible
Discount close to subtotal x discountAmount/100; order total close to subtotal - discount
Guest: no success message, invalid message and coupon row shown
Empty cart message visible after cleanup
evidence: Title: 'verify percent off order coupon functionality'
Spec note: ORDER50 is 40% off the whole order, profile-restricted to the signed-in user; the export's other-category check is disabled
Profile: ORDER50 is a Percent Off Order coupon on MaxwellsHardware, discount 40.0, orderMinimum 200; sku1 z-2100018 and sku2 z-2100022 are active in-stock simple products
Discount assertions use the resolved coupon's discountAmount (role data), not the literal 40.00
allProfiles false, profile Retail Customer (the signed-in user's profile); the guest (Anonymous) must not get it
orderMinimum 200.0 = the minimum order amount of the recorded coupon ORDER50 (work/profiles/profile.json, orderMinimum 200.0); the recorded quantities 1 and 8 are kept (User decision)

With substituted products (not the preferred z-2100018 / z-2100022) the cart at qty 1 may already reach 200 or the cart at qty 8 may stay below it, so the below-minimum and above-minimum steps may not hold
